metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: when Claude drafts a demand letter, does it just write from the facts, or does it check something first? Lands the carry-out that the checklist decides when a draft is ready, not Claude's judgment.

beats.narration_text: Someone asked whether Claude just writes a demand letter from the facts. It doesn't just write — it checks first. So: when Claude drafts one, does it check first?

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'When Claude drafts a demand letter, does it just write?', hesitates on 'just write', corrects to 'check first', lands the real question

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 20-35 word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('write' -> 'check first', landing 'does it just write?' -> 'does it just check first?') lands on screen. NOTE: triggerWords must be a SINGLE whitespace-delimited token — the component matches per-token, not phrase-wise; an earlier 'just write' (two words) never matched and the correction silently never fired.

beats.narration_text: A Skill is a folder Claude reads before it acts. This one is called demand-draft. Its one file, SKILL.md, holds the whole instruction set, written in plain language — no hidden logic. Claude reads it, then acts. The file is the program.
The instructions live in a Steps section. Claude reads each step in order and executes it — read the file, execute each step, return the result. Linear: no branching, unless a step says otherwise.

production_viz.label: READ, EXECUTE, RETURN
production_viz.caption: linear — no branching unless a step says so

beats.narration_text: One instruction inside it is specific: before any letter gets drafted, four checks have to clear — privilege, Rule 408, waiver, and admission. Only after that does Claude produce the draft, as a docx file, with a post-send checklist and an offer to open a matter.
Claude isn't deciding when a demand letter is ready to send — the checklist is: privilege, Rule 408, waiver, and admission all have to clear first.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: I have a completed intake for a demand letter. Read the demand-draft skill, and before you draft anything, walk me through the checklist you'll run first — privilege, Rule 408, waiver, admission — and what you still need from me.
